observationsNotFindings: The delta discipline in this family is now well established and this is its clearest instance. Twenty-six obligations, and the whole version difference is two new naming obligations plus one sentence added to an existing reason, with 23 of 24 shared obligations byte-identical. A join of this size is only auditable because the author keeps the delta that small.

FC-D9 is the detail most likely to trip a careless reader or a careless successor, and the join addresses it directly in two places: FC-D9 is one of the twelve live FC class names and is not a minted D9 code. Given that a separate obligation, OBL-D9-MAPPING, records that doctor's D9 and exit VALUES ride DR-007 while the contract binds structure only, the two could easily have been conflated into an apparent minting. They are not.

The join keeps two BLK groups apart that a summary would blur: OBL-BLK-1 through OBL-BLK-4 remain leftover-design at still-routed, while OBL-BLK-567-DISCHARGED is separately recorded as specified-not-leftover. A reader scanning only for 'BLK' would see both and could conclude either that all are open or that all are discharged.

Eight obligations remain leftover-design and three of them are the fixture authoring and execution halves. DR-114's practical remainder is therefore substantially larger than the two naming closes this version lands, and the join says so rather than implying momentum.

decision.summaryForCoordinator: No blockers, no should-fix. This is the largest join in the sweep - 26 obligations, 21 recorded inputs, 14 basedOn pins - and its delta is the tightest relative to size: nothing dropped, two new naming obligations, 23 of 24 shared obligations object-identical to v4, and one changed by reason text only. The two named-catalog obligations are correctly false while all three FX obligations stay true, so the naming close does not bleed into fixture authoring or execution. I traced the named lists from the harnesses up rather than trusting the catalogs: the g12 catalog's twelve FC classes equal live G12 v4 under ==, and live G21 v3 does carry namedCorpusWhenFixturesExist as five sublists which the g21 catalog covers with exactly five classes, including the doctor arm a careless catalog would have dropped. One entry read as a digest mismatch at first - 'D-163 commit historical' - because my check treated every non-HEAD key as a file path; it is a commit reference resolving to a real ancestor of HEAD whose subject is 'D-163: record permission-leftover-join.v2', and the 'historical' suffix is carried convention that permission-leftover-join v4 and v5 use identically. Net zero mismatches. FC-C1 and BLK-1..4 are live identifiers from actor-join v8, doctor v4 and host-effect v25 rather than inventions, and the join keeps them open while recording the separately discharged BLK-5/6/7 apart from them. No D9 code is minted; the thirteen D9 mentions are denials, the live FC-D9 class name, or the mapping obligation that rides DR-007 for values. No pin here is mine, though all the catalog and harness pins are single-reviewer. 20 attacks run, 20 refuted.
